Register of Deeds
Official Custodian of Land and Property Records
The Stanton County Register of Deeds is an elected official , responsible for recording, maintaining, and preserving the official public records of all real estate transactions and related documents within Stanton County, Kansas. This office ensures the integrity, accuracy, and accessibility of property records in accordance with Kansas law.
Core Responsibilities
The Register of Deeds is required by law to record all documents that are qualified to be recorded. These include, but are not limited to:
Deeds and mortgages
Oil and gas leases
Power of attorney documents
Cemetery deeds
Military discharges
UCC filings
Various affidavits and legal instruments
The office keeps a daily record of all transactions recorded and filed, and maintains accurate, permanent records for the citizens of Stanton County.
Public Access and Confidentiality
All records maintained by the Register of Deeds are open to the public for inspection during regular business hours, except for information contained on Sales Validation Questionnaires and Military Discharges , which are protected by law.
Fees and Financial Procedures
All fees for recording services are established by Kansas state statute and must be paid at the time of recording. At the end of each month, all fees collected are deposited into the Stanton County General Fund .
Commitment to Service
The Register of Deeds Office is committed to assisting the public with access to property records and general information. While staff cannot provide legal advice, they will make every effort to help locate requested information or refer individuals to appropriate resources when necessary.
